entry.title: He is half of my soul, as the poets say
entry.summary:
Author: To_spin_a_yarn

Rating: MatureLanguage: EnglishWords: 84,613Chapters: 11/40Kudos: 316

Summary: “My lord?” Gaius called. Arthur swallowed hard before turning around. “Yes?” he replied, his voice strangely neutral, far too clear for someone who felt as though his chest were being crushed from the inside. “I need you to tell me in detail what happened” the physician said. The effort to remain professional was obvious, to keep from showing the despair that must have been consuming him at the sight of his nephew in such a state. “There’s nothing to tell” Arthur said far too quickly, as though he wanted to end the matter before it gained any weight. “He was completely normal one second, and the next he was groaning in pain, with his eyes…” he made a vague gesture with his hand, unable to finish. Giving it shape would make it real, and he was not sure he could bear it. What difference did it make now? He’s dead, a cruel part of his mind whispered. “Then his eyes rolled back and he… fainted.” ⸻ Or: where Merlin’s soul travels back in time while fighting in the midst of the Second World War, and, in the process, his body in Camelot dies for a few minutes, sending Arthur Pendragon to the verge of fainting.

entry.title: I am your shield
entry.summary:
Author: FamilyDontEndWithBloood

Rating: MatureLanguage: EnglishWords: 35,502Chapters: 14/19Kudos: 96

Summary: ~ "I told you," he choked out, his voice a fierce growl right against Merlin's skin. "I am your shield." ~─── If the end of Merlin left you with a "Once and Forever Broken Heart", this is the story you were denied. As Merlin defies destiny to drag Arthur back from death, what they uncover is far more than a magic reveal. Driven by a devotion that shatters ancient prophecies and burns through Merlin’s soul, their fight leaves the raw truth of their feelings laid bare. Through an intimate, psychological, and epic path, they learn to navigate this new reality together. This is the journey of two men stepping beyond unspoken devotion into an absolute belonging—a bond growing from destiny to mind, from soul to skin, and deep into flesh and bone. It unfolds through the most subtle touch, the pure truth of their hearts, and the monumental choices shaping their realm. Healing is a gradual journey—from individual sacrifice to a kingdom rebuilding as a whole. Expect a fiercely protective King, a Court Sorcerer by his side as an equal, a rich slow-burn convergence of souls, and the unsparing emotional and physical payoff we were always promised.
